newsitem.title: USA: American Paging CEO Schaaf resigns.
newsitem.headline: American Paging CEO Schaaf resigns.

text.p: American Paging Inc said Wednesday president and chief executive officer John Schaaf has resigned to pursue other business interests.
He was replaced as president and chief executive by Terrence Sullivan, who had been senior vice president for operations and finance, the company said.
Schaaf also resigned his position on American Paging's board, the wireless messaging company said.
Sullivan joined American Paging in January, after being chief financial officer at Microelectronics and Computer Technology Corp, American Paging said.
